tagline.zh: 按 POUR 四原则(可感知/可操作/可理解/健壮)组织的 WCAG 2.2 速查清单:交付前按一致性等级(A/AA/AAA)逐条核对。
tagline.en: A WCAG 2.2 quick checklist organized by the four POUR principles (Perceivable/Operable/Understandable/Robust): audit item by item at your conformance level (A/AA/AAA) before shipping.

origin.zh: W3C WCAG 2.2 官方规范与 WebAIM WCAG 2 Checklist(按 POUR 分组、支持按 WCAG 版本与 A/AA/AAA 等级过滤);调研 07§36 引 WebAIM 键盘页(SC 2.1.2 无键盘陷阱属 Level A),对比度数值 4.5:1 / 3:1 与文本间距数值在调研 05§(WCAG 官方原文一手核对)。
origin.en: The W3C WCAG 2.2 spec and the WebAIM WCAG 2 Checklist (grouped by POUR, filterable by WCAG version and level A/AA/AAA); research 07 §36 cites WebAIM's keyboard page (SC 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap is Level A), and the 4.5:1 / 3:1 contrast figures plus text-spacing numbers were first-hand verified in research 05.

effect.zh: 显示「≤ 所选等级」的全部条目(AA 档 = A+AA;一致性是累进的)。22 条速查覆盖 POUR 四原则,SC 编号与等级为 WCAG 2.2 官方事实。
effect.en: Show every item at or below the chosen level (AA = A+AA; conformance is cumulative). The 22 quick items cover the four POUR principles; SC numbers and levels are official WCAG 2.2 facts.

note.zh: 纯 DOM 交互;进度用 meter 语义呈现。
note.en: Pure DOM interaction; progress uses meter semantics.

fallback.zh: 清单是流程工具,无特性降级;工程出口是把「勾选」变成流水线:CI 里跑 axe-core 类自动化(可查出约 30–50% 的常见问题),剩余靠人工按本清单走查(自动化无法判定替代文本是否恰当)。
fallback.en: The checklist is a process tool with nothing to degrade; the engineering exit is turning ticks into a pipeline: run axe-core-style automation in CI (catches roughly 30–50% of common issues), then a human walkthrough with this list (automation can't judge whether alt text is appropriate).

use.zh: 交付前走查:按所选等级逐条核对并记录证据
use.en: Pre-ship walkthrough: audit per item at your level and record evidence

use.zh: 新组件评审:对照 SC 2.1.1/2.1.2/4.1.2 先问键盘与语义
use.en: New-widget review: ask keyboard and semantics first against SC 2.1.1/2.1.2/4.1.2

use.zh: 写验收标准:把「4.5:1 / 焦点可见 / Esc 释放」写进 DoD
use.en: Writing acceptance criteria: put '4.5:1 / visible focus / Esc release' into the DoD

avoid.zh: 把「AAA」当成必须全达标的目标——WCAG 官方明确 AAA 不是全站要求
avoid.en: Treating AAA as a must-meet-everywhere goal — WCAG officially states AAA is not required site-wide

avoid.zh: 只在上线前跑一次自动化就宣布合规(自动化查不全)
avoid.en: One automated scan before launch declared as compliance (automation can't catch everything)

a11y.zh: 清单本身就是 a11y 主题:勾选框真实可操作、分组用 fieldset+legend、进度用 meter;条目文案保留 SC 编号便于回溯官方 Understanding 文档。
a11y.en: The checklist is its own topic: real checkboxes, fieldset+legend grouping, meter for progress; items keep SC numbers for tracing back to the official Understanding documents.

goal.zh: 做一个按 POUR 分组的 WCAG 速查清单:17 条常用 SC(编号+等级+一句话核对点),等级开关 A/AA/AAA 过滤,进度条实时显示已核对比例,分组用 fieldset/legend。
goal.en: Build a POUR-grouped WCAG quick checklist: 17 common SCs (number + level + one-line audit point), an A/AA/AAA level filter, a live progress meter, fieldset/legend grouping.

acceptance.zh: 17 条 SC 的编号/等级/数值(4.5:1、3:1、7:1、24px、0.1–0.16 倍字号间距等)为 WCAG 2.2 官方事实
acceptance.en: The 17 SCs' numbers/levels/values (4.5:1, 3:1, 7:1, 24px, 0.1–0.16× font-size spacing) are official WCAG 2.2 facts

acceptance.zh: level 为 JS 型参数;过滤语义为「≤ 所选等级」,与一致性累进一致
acceptance.en: level is a JS-type param; the filter means '≤ chosen level', matching cumulative conformance

acceptance.zh: 四个原则分组用 fieldset+legend,勾选框原生可键盘操作
acceptance.en: The four principle groups use fieldset+legend with natively keyboard-operable checkboxes

acceptance.zh: 进度以 meter 呈现并附「n/22」文本
acceptance.en: Progress renders as a meter with 'n/22' text

acceptance.zh: 每条附 SC 编号,可回溯官方 Understanding 文档
acceptance.en: Every item carries its SC number, traceable to the official Understanding docs
